$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: IN SYNC as of introspect-wasm@0.71.8 (core@216de5e, tag v0.71.8): the film-bug patch on top of the parity campaign's object styles, InDesign units and type on a path. Its catalog change: Capitalization's all-small-caps value is spelled CapToSmallCap, as InDesign writes it (was OTSmallCaps); paged.get reads a story's text with path "text"; paged.inspect answers a story address; paged.query documents style matching on text frames and stories; the shape builder's keep/remove unites the kept faces. Element geometry and path anchors gain an optional pageOrigin (wire only). No protocol change (71). Prior: in sync as of introspect-wasm@0.71.7 (core@ad571c7).
